title: Gemma: Open Models Based on Gemini Research and Technology

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using targeted coreference resolution and occupational stereotype benchmarks including Winogender and WinoBias, alongside broader social bias benchmark suites like CrowS-Pairs, BBQ, and BOLD.
